item.description: KOTA KINABALU (Jan 22): Sabah Economic Development Corporation (Sedco) Group subsidiaries that fail to achieve profitability within a year will face a management buyout process or be shut down. item.title: IRB targets to complete refund of excess company tax for Year of Assessment 2023 in the first quarter of 2026
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Inland Revenue Board (IRB) aims to complete the refund of excess company tax for the Year of Assessment 2023 in the first quarter of 2026, while the Year of Assessment 2024 is expected by the end of 2026. item.title: SRC civil suit: Najib admits RM42 million in personal account is not a donation from Saudi Arabia
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Datuk Seri Najib Tun Razak today admitted in the High Court here that the RM42 million deposited into his personal bank account had no connection to donations from Saudi Arabia. item.title: PDRM, Australian police foil attempt to smuggle heroin, MDMA worth RM80.3 million
item.description: KLANG: Police foiled an attempt to smuggle drugs to Australia, involving methylenedioxy-methamphetamine (MDMA) and heroin worth RM80.3 million, through an inspection of two containers at West Port, Klang on Jan 19.
